CVE-2022-46337 affects LDAP authentication in Derby 10.15.1.3 through 10.15.2.0. Advisory: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-rcjc-c4pj-xxrp The advertised 10.15.2.1 and 10.16.1.2 fixes are not available on Maven Central. The published fixed 10.17.1.0 release requires Java 21 and cannot run on this repository's Java 17 baseline: https://db.apache.org/derby/releases/release-10_17_1_0.cgi Keep the shared Derby family at 10.15.2.0 rather than introducing an incompatible minor upgrade. Interlok's embedded Derby usage does not enable LDAP authentication; LDAP injection/authentication bypass and disk-exhaustion risks remain if a deployment enables LDAP. This is an accepted conditional risk, not a remediation.

file name: spring-boot-loader-2.7.18.jar We are pinned to Spring Boot 2.7.x on Java 17. There is no newer 2.7.x release in Maven Central, so these CVEs cannot be remediated by an in-line version bump at the moment.

Accepted risks, not fixes, in the Jetty 10.0.26 family inherited from interlok-core/common. CVE-2026-2332 affects jetty-http 10.0.0 through 10.0.27 (fixed in 10.0.28): https://github.com/jetty/jetty.project/security/advisories/GHSA-355h-qmc2-wpwf CVE-2026-10050 affects jetty-security 10.0.0 through 10.0.26 (fixed in 10.0.31): https://github.com/jetty/jetty.project/security/advisories/GHSA-2fvj-hgj9-j2gr Checked 2026-11-06: Maven Central stops at 10.0.26; the advertised fixed 10.x artifacts return 404 from Central and the configured Adaptris public repository. No resolvable stable minor/patch fix is available. A maintained major upgrade is outside this remediation's constraints; Java 17 alone does not prohibit newer Jetty. Request smuggling/access-control bypass and Digest authentication credential collisions remain risks when affected HTTP parsing or authentication paths are used.
